run_nerf_evaluation: run the NeRF model evaluation on a test dataset using a saved checkpoint and Hydra config
run_nerf_video_export: run the NeRF model to export rendered frames as an MP4 video using ffmpeg
create_radiance_field_renderer: create a RadianceFieldRenderer model with configurable ray sampler and implicit function parameters
test_nerf_datasets: test the NeRF dataset loading by calling get_nerf_datasets for train, val, and test splits
review_generate_eval_video_cameras: review the generate_eval_video_cameras function to create camera trajectories for video rendering
